iris-bolt.$description: Iris Bolt — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ink-charcoal.$description: Ink Charcoal — Primary text, headings, body copy, footer headings, icon strokes — near-black navy that reads warmer than pure #000 on light surfaces

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Secondary body text, supporting copy where Ink Charcoal would feel too heavy

slate-veil.$description: Slate Veil — Muted helper text, secondary metadata, tertiary nav items, subtle icon fills

fog-mist.$description: Fog Mist — Placeholder text, disabled states, hairline icon strokes, low-emphasis borders

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — App store download badges, maximum-contrast text on light tinted panels, occasional icon detail

chalk-canvas.$description: Chalk Canvas — Page background, page-level canvas behind cards and content sections

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, modal backgrounds, input fields, raised panel fills

lilac-wash.$description: Lilac Wash — Tinted section backgrounds, subtle highlight zones, promotional banner fills

mist-border.$description: Mist Border — Hairline dividers, card edges, input borders, separator lines

hurmeno2-webfont.$description: hurme_no2-webfont — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

hurme-geometric-sans.$description: Single-family type system for all UI text. Weight 400 dominates body, nav, and most headings; 600 reserved for emphasis and button labels; 700 used sparingly for card titles. Hurme's geometric construction and open apertures give an approachable, textbook feel rather than corporate austerity.
